Priya N.: Heads-up  SIN terminal flagged 6x H200s on PO 2480 for firmware mismatch on arrival. Customs put a hold pending vendor inspection.
Zenith Supply Rep: Confirmed. Our manifest had mixed firmware build ids (v1.2.0 / v1.2.1) due to parallel imaging at the factory. Appears carrier scanned batch 2 separately, triggering QA hold.
Tom H.: Can we quarantine and flash locally at SAT depot or does customs require vendor inspection first?
Luca (Logistics): Customs requires vendor-signed inspection for firmware variance before release. Depot techs can flash but we need customs sign-off to clear import paperwork.
Alyssa - Procurement: cost/lead tradeoffs? if we ask for replacements from SG buffer, what's the expedited fee?
Zenith Supply Rep: Options: A) Ship 4x matched-firmware replacements from SG buffer tomorrow AM (air priority) at vendor freight cost + $2.5k/unit expedite fee. B) Arrange depot flash in SG (35d turnaround) with vendor covering depot labor but you cover customs broker uplift. C) Full RMA return-to-factory (long, ~3w).
Priya N.: We need immediate capacity for an APAC benchmark test on Wed. If we take 4 replacements, we still need 2 to pass canary. Can we get 2 temporary loaners in meanwhile?
Zenith Supply Rep: We can loan 2 refurbished H200s from local lanes for 72h with no charge if you sign the loaner SLA. They'll be different serials (temp-LOAN-*) and are tagged as not-for-production.
Tom H.: Not-for-production is fine for benchmarks. But accounting/audit needs serial traceability. Procurement: can ledger accept temp serials for 72h?
Alyssa - Procurement: ledger can handle temp serials but we need a signed asset handoff doc and a PO amendment referencing LOAN-2480. Also want vendor to provide build manifests for all units.
ops-bot: Event: PO 2480 - HOLD - SIN Terminal QA flag. Carrier AWB: SGN-555-001.
Priya N.: dropping manifest snippet:
```
PO: 2480-RED
AWB: SGN-555-001
SKU: H200-80GB
QTY: 6
Destination: SIN Depot B2
```
Luca (Logistics): practical ask: which option minimizes cost and time? Depot flash (B) sounds cheapest if vendor covers labor; but customs broker uplift will still be ~SGD 600 and storage SGD 120/day if beyond 48h.
Zenith Supply Rep: we'll cover depot labor and tests if you accept loaners + split shipment. We cannot cover customs broker per contract.
Tom H.: Can vendor produce firmware checksums and signed manifest within 12h? customs will want proof.
Zenith Supply Rep: Yes, we will upload signed build manifests, firmware checksums, and depot test photos within 12h.
Alyssa - Procurement: finance note: if vendor pays freight & depot labor but not broker fees, ask them to issue a credit note for broker uplift as a commercial concession. We'll push but no guarantee.
Priya N.: Decision: accept loaners (2) now, approve split shipment with 4 replacements shipping tomorrow, vendor to cover freight and depot labor, we cover customs broker for now and escalate credit. Condition: vendor must provide build manifests, checksums, and depot photos within 24h and chain-of-custody doc at handoff.
Zenith Supply Rep: Confirmed. Loaner units: LOAN-SIN-01, LOAN-SIN-02 assigned. Replacement AWB: SGN-777-888, ETA SG 08:45 local tomorrow. We'll upload manifests/checksums and signed handoff doc to shared folder.
ops-bot: Event: Replacement AWB created SGN-777-888 ETA 08:45 SGT.
Luca (Logistics): Jordan, tag runbooks: apac-alloc-fallback + loaner-checklist. I'll coordinate customs broker invoice and storage monitoring.
Tom H.: add requirement: vendor must include per-unit firmware revision in manifest (human readable) and a hash string for verification. Also request depot photo of serial + label.
Zenith Supply Rep: Affirmative. Firmware revision + SHA256 hash + depot photos will be provided.
Alyssa - Procurement: I'll prepare PO amendment LOAN-2480 and route for signatures. Finance, please hold the broker fee dispute until credit note request is processed.
Priya N.: thanks all. Postmortem action: procurement to add manifest firmware build_id validation to procurement checks to prevent mixed batch shipments. :memo:
